notes: Use built-in Codex image generation only; never call a paid image API.
The hero visualizes the identity-material decision before an app verification attempt.
The inline image is a distinct three-path troubleshooting flow, not a second hero variation.
Avoid readable private data, real identity numbers, logos, fake app interfaces, and text-heavy diagrams.
Avoid recent Korea-blog defaults such as traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, and cafe-table phone scenes.

prompt_policy.api_cost_policy: Do not call OpenAI Images API or external paid image APIs.
prompt_policy.prompt_method: Write a fresh one-off prompt for each role using this article's age-verification problem, the identity materials involved, and recent-image avoidance.
prompt_policy.diversity_rule: Hero and inline images must use different viewpoints, layouts, colors, and reader jobs; do not center a person holding a phone.
prompt_policy.quality_loop: Discard and regenerate any generic, repetitive, text-heavy, off-topic, logo-bearing, or internally similar result before publishing.

images.prompt: Fresh one-off editorial image for this specific article. Image role: hero decision moment. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Korea Easy Guide blog hero. Primary request: visualize the decision a foreign user faces when a Korean app requests age and real-name verification. Scene/backdrop: a clean Korean service-counter-inspired studio set, not an airport and not a cafe. Subject: a carefully arranged unbranded passport, neutral residence-card silhouette with all fields blank, small SIM card, secure age-gate token, and privacy shield arranged as three possible identity paths. Style/medium: premium tactile 3D editorial still life with realistic paper, plastic, and metal textures. Composition/framing: wide landscape, slight three-quarter overhead view, strong visual hierarchy, no person and no phone as the focal point. Lighting/mood: calm daylight, trustworthy, practical. Color palette: navy, warm ivory, muted coral, and brushed silver. Recent-image avoidance: avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, and cafe-table phone scenes. Constraints: no readable text, no numbers, no personal data, no national emblems, no logos, no brand marks, no fake app UI, no watermark. Avoid: traveler holding phone, luggage, airport terminal, Seoul skyline, cafe table, beauty products, generic cyber-security lock floating in space.

images.prompt: Fresh one-off process visual for this specific article. Image role: inline troubleshooting flow. Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: Korea Easy Guide inline explainer. Primary request: show a three-branch troubleshooting flow for Korean app verification without using readable labels. Scene/backdrop: pale stone work surface with a physical route board made from colored lines and objects. Subject: branch one pairs an unbranded passport with a camera aperture token; branch two pairs a sealed support envelope with a masked ID-card silhouette; branch three pairs a SIM card with a biometric fingerprint token and residence-card silhouette. Each branch ends in either a green check tile or an amber stop tile, making clear that platform support differs. Style/medium: top-down photographed physical infographic, crisp and educational, not a software screenshot. Composition/framing: wide landscape with three visibly separate routes and ample spacing; no people. Lighting/mood: bright neutral studio light, precise and reassuring. Color palette: teal, amber, slate blue, off-white. Recent-image avoidance: avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, and cafe-table phone scenes; do not make this a second hero still life. Constraints: no readable words, no letters, no numbers, no personal data, no logos, no brand marks, no fake app interface, no watermark. Avoid: second version of hero, centered smartphone, suitcase, airport, skyline, cafe, abstract glowing padlock, dense text.
